caption.text: Which one is holding you back? 👇 #musclegrowth #gymtips #workout #fitnesstips

text.style: cover line 1, lowercase, heaviest weight, text_dark
cover line 2, lowercase, heaviest weight, text_dark on an accent marker bar
heaviest weight, lowercase, text_dark on an accent marker bar

text.string: if you can’t see last week’s numbers, you can’t beat them.
text.style: regular, text_dark, up to two lines

text.string: write down every set, weight and rep.

slides.illustration: sitting on a flat bench between sets, looking down at a phone held in both hands (the screen is not visible)

text.style: heaviest weight, lowercase, text_dark on an accent marker bar

text.string: your muscles have no reason to grow.
text.style: regular, text_dark, up to two lines

text.string: add a rep or a little weight each week.

slides.illustration: standing, curling a very small dumbbell, looking bored

text.style: heaviest weight, lowercase, text_dark on an accent marker bar

text.string: the last hard reps are the ones that count.
text.style: regular, text_dark, up to two lines

text.string: end most sets 1-3 reps short of failure.

slides.illustration: flat barbell bench press, pushing hard at the end of a set, side three-quarter view

text.style: heaviest weight, lowercase, text_dark on an accent marker bar

text.string: a set here and there won’t build much.
text.style: regular, text_dark, up to two lines

text.string: give every muscle enough hard sets each week.

slides.illustration: pull-up on a bar, rear view

text.style: heaviest weight, lowercase, text_dark on an accent marker bar

text.string: some muscles get all the work, others get none.
text.style: regular, text_dark, up to two lines

text.string: balance your week across every muscle.

slides.illustration: front view, standing, from the thighs up: chest and arms filled #F26445, legs plain white (the imbalance is the point)

text.style: heaviest weight, lowercase, text_dark on an accent marker bar

text.string: no extra food, no new muscle.
text.style: regular, text_dark, up to two lines

text.string: eat enough protein and a little more food overall.

slides.illustration: sitting at a table with a large plate of chicken, rice and vegetables, side view, no brand names

text.style: heaviest weight, lowercase, text_dark on an accent marker bar

text.string: you grow while you recover, not while you lift.
text.style: regular, text_dark, up to two lines

text.string: get a full night of sleep, every night.

slides.illustration: lying asleep on a simple bed with a pillow, side view

text.string: harda tracks every set you lift and shows which muscles you’re skipping.
text.style: large, lowercase, heaviest weight, text_dark; accent marker bars under 'every set you lift' and 'which muscles you’re skipping'

text.string: log your workouts, beat last week, and keep every muscle in balance.
